crossRefs.note: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.
Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence.
When you did awesome things which we didn’t look for, you came down, and the mountains quaked at your presence.
You went out for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of your anointed. You crushed the head of the land of…
whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but…
God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings…
“Yahweh, when you went out of Seir, when you marched out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, the sky also…
The mountains quaked Yahweh’s presence, even Sinai at the presence of Yahweh, the God of Israel.
On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the…
All of Mount Sinai smoked, because Yahweh descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace…
When you heard the voice out of the middle of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you came near to…
You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!
Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.
I will give you the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that it is I, Yahweh…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Sinai
people.line: Mountain where Moses received the Ten Commandments

translations.web: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
translations.bsb: the earth shook and the heavens poured down rain before God, the One on Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.
translations.kjv: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
translations.asv: The earth trembled, The heavens also dropped rain at the presence of God: Yon Sinai trembled at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
